verdicts.reason: A and B share the same layout and differ only in a vertical shift of about 20px. Both have the same flaws: the divider is orphaned at the left, red, and no longer tied to the date. 'JULY 29' is shrunk to a small side-note wrapped onto two lines. The illustration cluster is crammed into the lower-left, leaving a dead right half. 'FOR BEGINNERS' and the GROVE.ONLINE ribbon are pushed against the bottom edge. Neither candidate is clearly better.
